prompt: Add Scale selection to the command palette. I type a percentage, like 50 or 150%, and the selected layers grow or shrink by that much about the centre of the selection: their sizes and their positions both scale, and everything inside a selected group or frame scales with it. It is one step to undo. Anything other than a positive number is refused and changes nothing. It is only offered when something is selected.
reference: One resize command with the exact scaled geometry for every selected layer and everything inside it.

naive.summary: Rounds every scaled x, y, width and height to two decimals before storing it.
